events.name: PortfolioReviewScheduled
events.trigger: Wealth Advisor creates a new portfolio review record (POST /wealth/v1/portfolio-reviews). PortfolioReviewRecord.status transitions to 'scheduled'. Published after the database write is committed (transactional outbox pattern).
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-006 (Wealth Platform / SVC-016); consumed by Notification Service (SVC-053) to dispatch client review confirmation. Also consumed by CAP-005 for regulatory activity monitoring.

derived_from.masking: None required — no sensitive PII in this event beyond client_id (pseudonymous)

consumers.action: Dispatches review confirmation email and portal notification to client; includes pre-meeting questionnaire link
Creates immutable audit log entry for review scheduling event

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-client strict ordering via client_id partition key on topic wealth.portfolio-reviews.
events.worm_rationale: Contains client_id (PII). Regulatory evidence of review scheduling activity for MiFID II COBS 9A and Consumer Duty audit trail. Retained 7 years.

events.name: SuitabilityAssessmentUpdated
events.trigger: SuitabilityAssessment questionnaire responses are submitted and the risk profile scoring and gap analysis complete. Published after ENT-047.status transitions to 'gap_analysis_complete' (or 'pending_hofs_signoff' if material change detected).
events.journey_phase_name: Client Risk Profile and Objectives Reassessment
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-006; consumed by Notification Service (SVC-053) to alert the advisor that client questionnaire is complete.

derived_from.masking: questionnaire_responses excluded — too large for event payload and contains detailed PII. suitability_gap_flags excluded — internal advisory data not required by consumers.

consumers.action: Alerts advisor dashboard: client questionnaire complete, risk profile updated

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-client strict ordering via client_id partition key on topic wealth.suitability.
events.worm_rationale: MiFID II COBS 9A requires audit trail of suitability assessment updates. PII (client_id, risk profile score). 7-year retention.

events.name: ClientAccountDataRequested
events.trigger: ALT-002 (PH-073): Advisor requests the rebalancing recommendation with cash_balance_requested=true. SVC-016 has no local copy of CAP-001 account data and must request it via async event.
events.journey_phase_name: Portfolio Performance Review and Rebalancing Recommendation
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-006 (SVC-016) to CAP-001 (SVC-001) via the Event Bus. Cross-capability data request — the only valid mechanism for SVC-016 to access CAP-001 data.

payload_schema.request_id: string (UUID v4) — correlation ID for async request-response
payload_schema.account_types_requested: array of string enum (current | savings | mortgage)

excluded_fields: All RebalancingRecommendation fields — this event requests external data, not derives from internal entity
derived_from.masking: Minimal payload — only client_id and account_types_requested. No balance or transaction data in request.

consumers.action: Looks up client accounts, assembles minimal summary (available_balance_gbp, account_type, snapshot_at), publishes EVT-107 (ClientAccountSummaryProvided) as response

events.ordering_guarantees: Correlation via request_id — SVC-001 includes request_id in EVT-107 response. No strict ordering requirement on request topic.
events.worm_rationale: Cross-capability data access request containing client_id. Audit evidence that data access was legitimate and purpose-limited.

events.name: SuitabilityReportGenerated
events.trigger: MiFID II suitability report PDF is successfully generated and stored. ENT-047.status transitions to 'report_generated'. Published before delivery to the client portal.
events.journey_phase_name: Client Instructions and Suitability Report Issuance
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by SVC-016; consumed by SVC-053 (Notification Service) to notify the client that the report is ready. No cross-capability routing required.

payload_schema.suitability_report_document_ref: string (S3 URI) — reference to the generated PDF

derived_from.masking: Full questionnaire data and cost tables excluded from event — too large; accessible via CAP-006 API.

consumers.action: Delivers suitability report ready notification to client portal and via email
Creates immutable audit log entry for suitability report generation

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-client strict ordering via client_id partition key on topic wealth.suitability.
events.worm_rationale: Evidence of suitability report generation is a COBS 9A audit trail requirement. S3 URI reference is included — the actual document is stored with 5-year WORM policy.

events.name: SuitabilityReportIssued
events.trigger: Suitability report is delivered to the client and ENT-047.status = 'issued'. Published atomically with the status update (transactional outbox). This is the critical cross-capability compliance registration event.
events.journey_phase_name: Client Instructions and Suitability Report Issuance
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-006 (SVC-016); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-014) to create a SuitabilityRecord in the central compliance audit trail. This is the mechanism by which CAP-005 knows a MiFID II suitability review has been conducted.

payload_schema.ex_ante_costs_charges_summary: object — total cost percentage (not full breakdown)

derived_from.masking: Full questionnaire and advisor notes excluded — not required by CAP-005 compliance record. Document ref excluded — SVC-014 does not store the PDF.

consumers.action: Creates SuitabilityRecord in CAP-005 compliance store. Maps event fields per service-boundaries.json maps_to specification.
Immutable WORM audit entry — COBS 9A 5-year minimum retention evidence

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-client strict ordering via client_id partition key on topic wealth.suitability. At-least-once delivery guaranteed.
events.worm_rationale: Core MiFID II COBS 9A compliance evidence. SuitabilityReportIssued is the regulatory proof that a compliant review was conducted. Minimum 5-year retention per COBS 9A; 7-year WORM pipeline retention applied.

events.name: InvestmentInstructionReceived
events.trigger: Client submits formal investment instruction (proceed_full | proceed_partial | decline). ENT-049 created. If instruction_type != decline, PH-075 trade execution initiated.
events.journey_phase_name: Client Instructions and Suitability Report Issuance
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by SVC-016; consumed by SVC-053 (Notification Service) and SVC-103 (Audit). Internal to CAP-006 workflow trigger.

derived_from.masking: orders array excluded — contains trade detail not required by notification/audit consumers at instruction receipt stage.

consumers.action: Sends advisor confirmation that client instruction has been received
Immutable audit entry — client investment instruction recorded with timestamp for COBS 9A audit trail

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-client strict ordering via client_id partition key on topic wealth.investment-instructions.
events.worm_rationale: Client investment instruction is a regulated action. COBS 9A requires the instruction to be recorded with timestamp and circumstances. WORM retention 7 years.

events.name: PortfolioReviewCompleted
events.trigger: All rebalancing trades are confirmed (execution_status = fully_executed or partially_executed) OR client has declined (instruction_type = decline). PortfolioReviewRecord.status transitions to 'reporting'. Published at end of PH-075.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by SVC-016; consumed by SVC-053 (Notification Service) to dispatch trade execution confirmation to client and advisor.

derived_from.masking: Detailed order array and MiFIR transaction refs excluded — sensitive financial data not required by notification consumers.

consumers.action: Dispatches trade execution confirmation to client (PER-004) and advisor (PER-057) via portal and email
Immutable audit entry for review execution completion

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-client strict ordering via client_id partition key on topic wealth.portfolio-reviews.
events.worm_rationale: Portfolio execution completion is a financial event. MiFID II transaction reporting obligation for executed orders. 7-year WORM retention.

events.name: ConsumerDutyEvidenceCompleted
events.trigger: Advisor completes the portfolio review (POST /portfolio-reviews/{review_id}/complete). ConsumerDutyEvidenceRecord (ENT-051) is created and compliance_submitted_at is set. Published cross-capability to CAP-005 for compliance tracking.
events.journey_phase_name: Post-Review Reporting and Consumer Duty Evidence
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-006 (SVC-016); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-014) to update the Consumer Duty monitoring register for FCA supervisory reporting.

payload_schema.total_fee_charged_gbp: decimal — total advisory/management fee for the period
payload_schema.fair_value_assessment_score: string enum (fair_value_met | fair_value_borderline | fair_value_gap) — encrypted in transit
payload_schema.service_activities_count: integer — number of documented service activities delivered

field_mappings.notes: Encrypted in payload; SVC-014 decrypts with shared key

derived_from.masking: fair_value_assessment_score is encrypted in the event payload. service_activities_delivered array excluded — too verbose; count sufficient for compliance aggregation. Full detail accessible via CAP-006 API.

consumers.action: Creates ConsumerDutyComplianceRecord in CAP-005 compliance store. If remediation_required=true, raises compliance alert to Head of Compliance dashboard.
Triggers dispatch of annual service statement to client
Immutable 7-year WORM audit entry — Consumer Duty evidence

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-client strict ordering via client_id partition key on topic wealth.consumer-duty.
events.worm_rationale: Consumer Duty evidence is a regulatory record. FCA may require evidence of fair value assessments for supervisory review. 7-year WORM retention per Consumer Duty regulatory timeline.
